frozen_on: 2026-11-04, before any model inference on this cohort
dataset: PhysioNet 'A large scale 12-lead electrocardiogram database for arrhythmia study' v1.0.0 (Zheng et al.; Chapman University / Shaoxing People's Hospital / Ningbo First Hospital), CC BY 4.0, 45,152 WFDB records, 500 Hz, 10 s; all 90,759 files verified against the official SHA256SUMS.txt
code_dictionary_sources: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021 dx_mapping_scored.csv / dx_mapping_unscored.csv (github.com/physionetchallenges/evaluation-2021, sha256 fad13ad9... / ce53c9e3...) for header codes absent from the shipped file
reference_standard: physician labels (two licensed physicians, senior physician on disagreement) stored in GE MUSE, exported as SNOMED CT codes; PTB-XL labels are cardiologist-annotated SCP-ECG statements. Different coding systems and annotation protocols.

CD.name: CD (AV block 1st/2nd/3rd/unspecified degree; RBBB and LBBB complete/incomplete/unspecified; LAFB; LPFB; nonspecific IVCD; unspecified BBB; WPW / ventricular pre-excitation)
CD.ptbxl_target: CD = {1AVB, 2AVB, 3AVB, CLBBB, CRBBB, ILBBB, IRBBB, LAFB, LPFB, IVCD, WPW}
CD.coverage: all 11 PTB-XL CD statements have a counterpart; note the shipped dictionary also files LAFB/LPFB free-text labels under 164909002 (LBBB) -- all CD either way

positive_codes.233917008: AV block, degree unspecified -> CD (every PTB-XL AVB degree is CD)
positive_codes.59118001: RBBB unspecified -> CRBBB or IRBBB (both CD)
positive_codes.164909002: LBBB unspecified (also used for LAFB/LPFB text in this DB) -> CD

ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.164947007: prolonged PR interval (52) -- may be the 1AVB criterion itself; needs clinician decision
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.50799005: AV dissociation (59) -- no PTB-XL CD counterpart
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.65778007: sinoatrial block (5) -- conduction disorder, no PTB-XL CD counterpart
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.418818005: Brugada (5) -- RBBB-like pattern, no PTB-XL counterpart
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.49578007: short PR interval (23) -- pre-excitation-related, not WPW

STTC_partial.name: STTC-partial (nonspecific ST-T abnormality, ST change, T-wave abnormality/inversion, ST depression, prolonged QT)
STTC_partial.ptbxl_target: STTC = {NDT, NST_, ISC_, ISCAL, ISCAN, ISCAS, ISCLA, ISCIN, ISCIL, ANEUR, DIG, EL, LNGQT}
STTC_partial.coverage: PARTIAL: lead-territory ischemia subclasses, DIG, EL and ANEUR have no separate code; reported as a partial STTC endpoint, never as the PTB-XL STTC endpoint

ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.164930006: 'ST interval abnormal' (801; shipped dictionary: 'ST extension') -- meaning unclear
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.164931005: ST elevation (176) -- PTB-XL files ST elevation under injury/MI or a form statement, not STTC
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.428417006: early repolarization (366) -- no PTB-XL diagnostic counterpart
ambiguous_codes_excluded_unless_a_positi.164937009: U wave abnormal (136) -- possibly EL, unclear

negative_definition: a record is negative for an outcome only if it has >= 1 SNOMED code, none of that outcome's positive codes and none of its ambiguous codes; all codes in this cohort are physician labels for the whole record. Unannotated records are never assumed negative (1 record with empty Dx is excluded).
global_exclusions_in_order: any non-finite sample (97; refused by the frozen adapter)
any flat lead (peak-to-peak < 1 uV) -- the K=1 selector could choose a dead lead
any sample at the int16 clipping limit (|x| >= 32.76 mV)
both members of every exact-duplicate signal pair (87 pairs; 43 pairs disagree on Dx or age)
pacing rhythm 10370003 (1182) -- paced QRS; outcome mapping needs clinician decision; excluded from both outcomes in the primary analysis
sampling_unit: record. The documentation states 45,152 ECGs from 45,152 patients, but headers carry no patient identifier, so one-record-per-patient cannot be verified; intervals resample records.
overlap: No overlap with the training source (PTB-XL, Germany 1989-96, Schiller devices) is possible: different country, era, device and hospitals. The first 10,646 records were earlier released on figshare (2020) and the cohort was redistributed as 'Chapman-Shaoxing' and 'Ningbo' in the PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021; none of these were used for any training here.
preprocessing: frozen adapter revision_audit/external_validation_plan/external_pipeline.py::to_training_format (lead reorder by name, mV, resample_poly 500->100 Hz, first 10 s), then PTB-XL per-lead z-score from outputs/norm_stats.npz; nothing fitted on external data
rule_for_confirmation_changes: the primary analysis uses this frozen file. Any clinician-confirmed change is applied as a separately labelled sensitivity analysis with its own frozen file; the primary result is not replaced.
